category: no-code scraper with a desktop task builder

free_tier.stated: Free plan, no expiry and no credit card: 10 tasks, 1 device, 2 concurrent local runs, unlimited pages per crawl, up to 50,000 exported rows a month and 10,000 rows per export, as Excel, CSV, JSON, HTML or XML; extraction is local only, with no cloud extraction, no API access and no task scheduling. Preset templates run in the cloud through the MCP server at 2,000 records a week
free_tier.notes: the true units are exported data rows (50,000 a month, 10,000 per export) for custom tasks and extracted records (2,000 a week) for MCP template runs; no vocabulary term names a row or a record. The MCP allowance reads 2,000 records per week on the help center and 2,000 records per month on the MCP docs page

per_object_cap.stated: 10,000 data rows per export on Free; unlimited on paid plans
per_object_cap.notes: a per-export row cap, not a byte cap

retention.stated: local runs save data on the device that ran them and Free keeps the history of the last 5 local runs; cloud data retention (30, 60 or 90 days) applies to paid plans only

egress.terms: not applicable: exported files and database or Google Sheets exports

interface_detail: Free: the Octoparse desktop application (Windows 10 64-bit or later, and macOS) builds and runs tasks by point and click, and a remote MCP server at https://mcp.octoparse.com runs preset templates in the cloud and exports JSON or CSV. The OpenAPI starts at Standard (Data Export API) and Professional (Advanced API); Free has no API access. The true interface terms are a desktop application and MCP, which the vocabulary lacks
tooling: the Octoparse desktop application, installed and run by the user on a Windows 10 64-bit or macOS machine (rented or free); any MCP-compatible AI tool (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code) for the template lane
chaining: Free custom tasks extract only on the machine running the desktop application, which must stay on for the run, so a rented or free Windows or macOS desktop is the host; the MCP lane runs preset templates on Octoparse cloud nodes and hands JSON or CSV to an AI agent with no machine at all

limits.value: 50,000 exported data rows a month on Free; unlimited on paid plans
up to 10,000 data rows per export on Free
2 concurrent local runs, 10 stored tasks and 1 logged-in device on Free; 0 concurrent cloud runs
MCP/API template extraction: 2,000 records a week on Free and Basic, reset at the end of each natural week, unused records not carried over; the MCP docs page states 2,000 records a month
preset template results can be previewed but not exported in-app on Free; export goes through the MCP server or a paid plan
Free keeps the history of the last 5 local runs

binding_note: 50,000 exported rows a month caps everything a custom task yields on Free; the 10,000-row export cap and 2 concurrent local runs only shape a single job, and the template lane is a separate 2,000-record weekly allowance

identity_cost.detail: the Free plan needs no credit card; sign-up is by email address with a verification code, or by Google or GitHub sign-in. The 14-day trial of a paid plan asks for a payment method

reliability_note: Free runs depend on the device, network and address of the machine that runs them: IP rotation, residential proxies and automatic CAPTCHA solving are paid features, so a protected site blocks a Free run sooner
confidence_note: every value is read from Octoparse's own pricing page (including the per-plan feature table embedded in it), docs, help center and blog; the MCP template allowance disagrees between the help center (2,000 records per week) and the MCP docs page (2,000 records per month)

notes: Confirmed as a no-code scraper with a free plan. Free runs: no run count is stated; 2 local runs at a time, history of the last 5. Pages per run: unlimited pages per crawl, bounded instead by 10,000 rows per export and 50,000 rows a month. Export formats: Excel, CSV, JSON, HTML, XML, plus database export (MySQL, SQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) and Google Sheets through a service account on Free. The caveat is where Free extraction runs: custom tasks run only in the desktop application on the user's own Windows or macOS machine; the only hosted lane on Free is MCP template extraction (2,000 records a week). Cloud extraction starts at Standard, from USD 69 a month billed annually.
